app.name: FordCast
map.title: Every crossing has a story.
map.body: Explore 141 low-water crossings around Austin. Check upstream gauge evidence before you travel.
map.search: Search a crossing, road, or creek
map.coverage_body: 12 crossings have verified flood thresholds (Tier A) and 18 have upstream gauge links (Tier B). 111 inventory locations remain Not monitored (Tier C). Live polling is offline in this prototype; use Storm Replay to inspect out-of-sample backtests.
map.preview_body: Shows real Austin & Travis County coordinates, upstream USGS gauges, and linked creek flowlines.
map.failed: Map details unavailable. Use the crossing list below.
map.attribution: City of Austin · Travis County Public Works · USGS Water Data
state.avoid_spoken: Avoid. Flooding likely soon. Take another route.
state.closed_spoken: Flooded. Closed. Never drive into water.
state.unknown_body: No live upstream telemetry is connected right now. Follow official warnings and posted barricades.
state.now: Water may already be on the road
reason.UPSTREAM_ABOVE_TRIGGER: {{gauge}}: +{{rise}} ft over the last 30 min, upstream. Water usually takes {{tau_lo}}–{{tau_hi}} min to get here.
reason.WATER_AT_ROAD: Gauge {{gauge}} is at {{stage}} ft (road overtop threshold {{overtop}} ft)
crossing.title: Crossing detail
crossing.travel_time: Typical travel time: {{tau_lo}}–{{tau_hi}} min ({{dist}} km channel)
replay.title: See the water rise.
replay.body: Scrub through 5 real Central Texas storms scored with Leave-One-Storm-Out cross-validation and 60-minute data-arrival delay.
replay.caption: USGS archived gauge height · feet (with 60-min telemetry arrival delay)
replay.caveat: Out-of-sample replay using parameters learned on the other storms only. Outage gaps are hidden until archive backfill.
replay.pending_body: Evaluated across 12 Tier-A crossings and 5 storms with 60-minute data-arrival delay.
replay.archive: USGS Water Data OGC API v1 · NOAA NWPS
replay.chart_label: Historical gauge-height chart with trigger threshold and outage shading.
replay.gauge_silent: {{gauge}} went silent. Its readings only arrived later, so FordCast shows Unknown here.
replay.result: FordCast flagged Avoid {{lead}} min before the road flooded.
replay.honesty: Across {{n}} storms and {{m}} crossings: median lead time {{med}} min, {{false_alarms}} false alarms, {{missed}} missed.
replay.metrics_row: POD {{pod}}% · FAR {{far}}% · CSI {{csi}} · Median lead {{lead}} min
drive.title: Eyes on the road.
drive.body: High-contrast status HUD with bilingual spoken alerts and NHTSA passenger lockout above 15 mph.
drive.lockout_active: Driving lockout active (>15 mph). Interactive browsing disabled.
alerts.title: Your crossings.
alerts.body: Saved on this device. Toggle early Watch alerts per crossing or test how a local alert sounds.
alerts.empty_body: Save a crossing from its detail screen to find it here.
alerts.test: TEST: Avoid {{crossing}} — water rising upstream. Likely at road in {{lo}}–{{hi}} min.
settings.title: Make it yours.
settings.about_body: FordCast links upstream USGS stream gauges to downstream low-water crossings using river-network travel times and Leave-One-Storm-Out cross-validation.
settings.privacy_body: Saved crossing IDs, language, and your pledge are stored on this device. No personal location history leaves your phone.
settings.review: Bilingual EN/ES strings verified for placeholder and safety-lexicon parity.
settings.sources_body: Inventory: City of Austin Open Data and Travis County Public Works. Gauges & flowlines: USGS NLDI & NOAA NWPS. Historical readings: USGS Water Data OGC API v1.
onboarding.pledge.title: Before you start
onboarding.pledge.item1: I will never drive into water.
onboarding.pledge.item2: I will obey barricades and official warnings.
onboarding.pledge.item3: FordCast is a student-built forecast. It can be wrong or late, and it never tells me a road is safe.
onboarding.pledge.hint: Check all three statements to continue
onboarding.prototype: Prototype with 5 real historical storm replays and 30 monitored crossings.
legend.title: Read the signs.
legend.body: Shape, symbol and words carry the meaning together.
legend.no_rise: No upstream rise detected; road conditions are not confirmed.
legend.watch: Water is rising upstream. Flooding is possible.
legend.avoid: Flooding is likely soon. Take another route.
legend.closed: Water at the road or a reported official closure.
disclaimer: FordCast is a supplementary tool. Obey barricades and official warnings. Never drive into water.
error.storage: Device storage is unavailable. Preferences will last only for this session.
